target.name: Western Asset Global Partners Income Fund Inc.

acquirer.name: Western Asset Global High Income Fund Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Western Asset Global Partners Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: GDF) and Western Asset Global High Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: EHI) today announced approval by each Fund’s Board of Directors of a proposal to merge Western Asset Global Partners Income Fund Inc. with and into Western Asset Global High Income Fund Inc., subject to approval by the stockholders of each Fund.

announcement.quote: today announced approval by each Fund’s Board of Directors of a proposal to merge Western Asset Global Partners Income Fund Inc. with and into Western Asset Global High Income Fund Inc., subject to approval by the stockholders of each Fund.

deals.notes: Joint special meeting set for 2016-07-22; the DEFA14A filed 2016-07-25 says it was adjourned to 2016-08-12 because there were insufficient votes cast. A further DEFA14A (2016-08-01) repeats this. No excerpt states the result of the 2016-08-12 meeting or whether the merger closed or failed; the 2016-09-01 DEF 14A, 2017-08-17 8-K and 2017-08-29 DEF 14A excerpts (compact) show no outcome language.

problems: Outcome not stated in the excerpts.
